contentText:
Olivia Rodrigo takes over the top 10 of the Billboard Hot 100 with “Honeybee,” “Stupid Song” and more, but will any of her four entries take over Taylor Swift’s “I Knew It, I Knew You” No. 1 spot this week?

Tetris Kelly: This is the Billboard Hot 100 top 10 for the week dated June 27. Olivia’s “Man I Need” falls to 10. “Honeybee” debuts at nine. “Ariana’s “Hate That I Made You Love Me” slips to eight. Drake’s “Janice STFU” falls to seven. “The Cure” rises to six. “Be Her” is back to five. “Drop Dead” leaps to four, and Olivia Rodrigo’s “Stupid Song” debuts at three. “Choosin’ Texas” is still at two, and Taylor Swift’s “I Knew It, I Knew You” spends its second week at No. 1.
